cards.headline:
Boya Notra Neo brings AI notes
to a MagSafe voice recorder
cards.body: Boya's MagSafe recorder transcribes calls in 140+ languages, tags speakers, and drafts AI summaries.

blocks.cap: The colorful, petite Boya Notra Neo delivers AI-powered meeting transcriptions and summaries.

blocks.x: Boya has unveiled the Notra Neo, an AI-powered voice recorder designed to simplify note-taking during calls and meetings. It has ambient, phone call and Bluetooth recording modes, with on-board and cloud storage.

The Notra Neo supports transcription in more than 140 languages and includes smart speaker identification. The AI can generate summaries, action items and mind maps using more than 60 professional templates, and Ask AI lets users find specific information across their recorded files.

blocks.cap: Two MEMS microphones capture voices up to 5 m (16.4 ft.) away.

blocks.x: It has 8 GB of local storage and records continuously for up to 20 hours; recharging takes 1.5 hours. Recordings sync via the Boya OS app to free unlimited cloud storage and export in 10 formats. Boya says data is end-to-end encrypted and HIPAA-compliant.

The recorder costs $79.99 in black, white, neon yellow and light pink, weighing 34.5 g. Plans: free Starter (600 minutes/month, 10 templates), Pro at $17.99/month (1,280 minutes, 40 templates, Ask AI) and Ultimate at $29.99/month (unlimited transcription, all 60 templates).

blocks.cap: The Boya Notra Neo comes with a MagSafe-compatible magnetic mount.
